faqsSection.title: Frequently asked questions
faqsSection.description: From using the platform to booking appointments, we’re here to guide you. Check out the answers to the most common questions from our community.

items.title: How do I book, reschedule, or cancel an appointment?
items.content: You can easily manage your appointments directly in the app—just choose a time slot that works for you, or go to your dashboard to reschedule or cancel. You'll receive automatic reminders to help you stay organized.

items.title: What happens if I need urgent medical attention?
items.content: If you require urgent medical care, please call emergency services immediately. The app should not be used for emergencies.

items.title: Are my personal and medical details safe with Medvisit?
items.content: Yes, all your information is encrypted and securely stored in compliance with healthcare data regulations.

items.title: Can I get a prescription or referral through the app?
items.content: Yes, licensed professionals on the platform can provide prescriptions or referrals when appropriate.

termsConditions.introduction: Welcome to MedVisit, your trusted medical booking platform. These Terms and Conditions govern your use of our services, including doctor appointments, medical consultations, and related healthcare services. Please read these terms carefully as they contain important information about your rights and obligations.

We will notify users of any material changes via email or through our platform. Your continued use of the service after such modifications constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

section2.content: MedVisit is a platform that facilitates connections between patients and healthcare providers. We do not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. All medical information provided through our platform is for informational purposes only and should not be considered as medical advice. Always consult with qualified healthcare professionals for medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. In case of medical emergencies, contact emergency services immediately.

You agree to provide accurate, current, and complete information during registration and to update such information to keep it accurate, current, and complete. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activities that occur under your account. You must notify us immediately of any unauthorized use of your account.

The relationship between you and healthcare providers is independent of MedVisit. We are not responsible for the quality of medical care provided by healthcare providers or for any medical decisions made by them. Healthcare providers are responsible for their own licensing, credentials, and professional conduct.

section5.title: 5. PRIVACY AND DATA PROTECTION
section5.content: Your privacy is important to us. We collect, use, and protect your personal and health information in accordance with our Privacy Policy and applicable laws, including HIPAA where applicable. We implement appropriate security measures to protect your data. By using our service, you consent to the collection and use of your information as described in our Privacy Policy. We may share your information with healthcare providers you choose to see through our platform.

section6.title: 6. PAYMENT AND BILLING
section6.content: Payment for medical services is typically handled directly between you and the healthcare provider. MedVisit may facilitate payment processing but is not responsible for billing disputes between patients and providers. All fees and charges are non-refundable unless otherwise specified. You are responsible for any applicable taxes. We reserve the right to change our fee structure at any time with reasonable notice.

section7.title: 7. CANCELLATION AND RESCHEDULING
section7.content: Appointment cancellations and rescheduling are subject to the policies of individual healthcare providers. Generally, cancellations must be made at least 24 hours in advance to avoid cancellation fees. No-show fees may apply for missed appointments. MedVisit is not responsible for provider-specific cancellation policies or fees. Please review individual provider policies before booking appointments.
